body: Stephen A. Smith has stated that Dan Quinn's tenure with the Washington Commanders is over, a claim reported by Yahoo Sports and The Comeback. Concurrently, reports indicate Quinn has hired a former head coach while his future with the Commanders remains uncertain.

findings.evidence_quote: Stephen A. Smith Says Dan Quinn's Time in Washington Is Over as the Commanders Hit Their Bye
Dan Quinn Hires Former Head Coach Amid Uncertain Future With Commanders
